verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents velocity/authorization controls, transaction retrieval, dispute case management, and webhooks for event notifications, plus a general marketing claim to 'detect fraud, control your spend' — but there is no concrete documentation of network fraud scores or Marqeta's own fraud-scoring models surfaced at authorization time, no described suspicious-activity alerting mechanism, and no explicit card block-and-reissue workflow for compromised cards. missing for 10: fraud score/model detail at auth time, suspicious-activity alert mechanism, explicit card block/reissue tooling for compromised cards, independent corroboration of fraud detection efficacy.
